description_en: Creates a data source in a specified project workspace for the development or production environment
description_zh: 在指定项目空间创建一条数据源，可以是开发环境或生产环境
name: CreateDataSource

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the DataWorks workspace. You can log on to the DataWorks console (https://dataworks.console.aliyun.com/overview) and go to the Workspace Management page to obtain the ID.

This parameter specifies the DataWorks workspace for this API call
parameters.help_zh:
DataWorks工作空间的ID。您可以登录DataWorks控制台 (https://dataworks.console.aliyun.com/overview)，进入工作空间管理页面获取ID。

该参数用来确定本次API调用操作使用的DataWorks工作空间
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the data source. The name can contain letters, digits, and underscores (_), and cannot start with a digit or underscore. The name can be up to 255 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 数据源的名称，由字母、数字、下划线组合，且不能以数字和下划线开头，最长255 个字符
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The type of the data source. More than 70 data source types are supported. For more information about the enumerated data source types, refer to References: https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2852465.html
parameters.help_zh: 数据源的类型，目前已经支持数据源类型 70+，数据源类型枚举说明参考文档：https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2852465.html
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en:
The connection mode of the data source. Different types have different subtypes with different parameter constraints. For example, a MySQL data source supports the following modes:
InstanceMode (instance mode)
UrlMode (connection string mode)
parameters.help_zh:
数据源添加的类别，不同Type下会有不同的子类型，对应有不同的参数约束，以MySQL数据源举例有：
InstanceMode（实例模式）
UrlMode（连接串模式）
parameters.name: connection_properties_mode

parameters.help_en: The description of the data source. The description can be up to 3,000 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 数据源描述信息，长度不超过 3000 个字符
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The connection properties of the data source, including the endpoint, access identity, and environment context. The envType property is a member of this object and specifies the data source environment. Valid values:
Dev: development environment.
Prod: production environment.

Different data source types have different property specifications under different connection patterns (ConnectionPropertiesMode). For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2852465.html
parameters.help_zh:
数据源的具体连接配置信息，包括连接地址、访问身份、环境信息等。数据源环境envType信息是此对象的成员属性，包括
Dev（开发环境）
Prod（生产环境）

不同类型的数据源在不同的配置模式（ConnectionPropertiesMode）下具有不同的属性信息规范，请参考https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2852465.html
parameters.name: connection_properties
